SELECT /*LGVPAYP0003.retrievePayrollItemList*/ ppi.payroll_item_id , ppi.inquiry_name , ccm.common_code_name , pcm.payroll_apply_flag FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n cpb , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c ccm , tb_pay_calc_mthd_n pcm WHERE 1=1 AND cpb.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ( ppi.end_yyyymmdd is NULL OR ppi.end_yyyymmdd >= cpb.end_yyyymmdd) AND ccm.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE' AND ccm.common_code = ppi.pay_item_classification_code AND ccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcm.payroll_item_id AND pcm.payroll_calc_method_code = 'RECURRING_FLAG'
AND UPPER(ppi.inquiry_name) like '%' || UPPER(#{inquiryName}) || '%'
AND cpb.payroll_calc_period_value = #{payrollCalcPeriodValue}
ORDER BY ppi.payroll_item_id
